key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week as oil surged past $100/bbl and global rate-hike fears intensified, dragging miners and banks lower
Iron ore entering a 'bloodletting' phase, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX valuations
AUD weakened sharply on growth scare, though supported by rising crude and T-Note yields
RBA flagged rental inflation as a key concern, complicating rate path amid sticky CPI
ANZ.AX completed 3,500-job cut but strategic transformation still faces execution risk
Australian gas supply rules softened, easing Asian energy security fears and supporting Santos.AX, Woodside.AX
Housing market bifurcating: high-end prices falling steeply while affordable segment remains resilient
Queensland credit rating downgrade raises sovereign risk premium for Qld-linked assets
Mining sector cap-raise activity surging (Canaccord-led), signalling capital stress among juniors
Woolworths.AX 'Price Freeze' breach and 177-store closures at women's fashion chain signal consumer pressure

sectors.trend: Sharp negative. Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; ASX miners led the $90bn weekly sell-off. Junior miners scrambling for capital via cap raises. Gold-silver explorers (Kuniko, Gateway WA) showing relative resilience.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression on iron ore. Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) and battery-tech (CRB.AX) offer diversification. Avoid capital-weak juniors amid cap-raise dilution risk.

sectors.trend: Negative. Banks dragged ASX lower alongside miners. ANZ.AX post-restructuring still faces execution risk. RBA rental-inflation concern may delay rate cuts, pressuring NIMs. Qld credit downgrade adds sovereign risk.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX under pressure from rising bond yields and delayed RBA easing. Qld-linked exposures (REITs, infrastructure) face higher cost of capital.

sectors.trend: Mixed-positive. Oil surge past $100/bbl benefits upstream producers but raises input costs. Australia softening gas supply rules supports Santos.AX, Woodside.AX. Permian gas weakness is a US-specific signal.
sectors.implications: Santos.AX, Woodside.AX, AGL.AX benefit from policy support and oil strength. Fuel price rise (+30c/L) pressures transport and consumer sectors.

sectors.trend: Negative. Woolworths.AX 'Price Freeze' breach erodes trust. 177-store fashion closures signal demand weakness. Australian businesses reporting fear for future. Tax burden rising.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure from input costs vs. pricing power limits. Consumer discretionary names under pressure. Defensive staples preferred.

sectors.trend: Neutral-positive. SA aged-care crisis and proton therapy delays highlight structural gaps. Superannuation system under political scrutiny but remains structurally sound.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX benefit from long-term healthcare demand. Super fund managers (HUB.AX, PPA.AX) face political risk but strong inflows.

sectors.trend: Divergent. High-end residential prices falling steeply; affordable segment resilient. First-home buyer surge. NZ housing correction still running. RBA rental inflation concern is a headwind.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face rental yield compression risk. Residential builders (MPL.AX, GPT.AX) may see volume support from first-home buyers.

key_themes: Global oil shock ($100/bbl) driving rate-hike fears and equity sell-off
Iron ore structural weakness pressuring ASX materials weight
AUD volatility: growth scare vs. commodity/yield support
RBA caught between rental inflation and growth slowdown
Mining sector capital stress and dilution risk
Housing market bifurcation: luxury correction vs. affordable resilience
Superannuation political risk (One Nation, populism debate)
Chinese inflation surge and geopolitical trade routing shifts
Consumer pricing power erosion across staples

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global oil shock and rate-hike repricing
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge equity exposure with energy long positions; reduce duration in rate-sensitive sectors; monitor Fed and RBA guidance closely
Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold and battery metals; monitor Chinese PMI and property data
Favour floating-rate credit; reduce REIT and long-duration bond exposure; watch rental CPI data
Avoid small-cap miners with weak balance sheets; focus on cash-flow-positive producers
Review Qld-linked infrastructure and REIT exposures; monitor state budget updates

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Consumer demand erosion / pricing power loss
risk_assessment.mitigation: Prefer value-oriented consumer staples; avoid discretionary names with weak pricing power

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Australian gas and oil producers on policy support and $100 oil
opportunities.rationale: Softened gas supply rules + oil surge create favourable revenue environment; Santos and Woodside benefit from Asian demand

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate into gold and battery metals as iron ore weakens
opportunities.rationale: Gold-silver exploration (Kuniko, Gateway WA) and battery tech (Critical Resources) offer diversification away from iron ore cycle
Affordable segment resilient while luxury corrects; builders with entry-level pipeline benefit from buyer surge

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce ASX materials and bank exposure; hedge with short ^AXJO or long volatility
defensive_moves.rationale: $90bn weekly sell-off, iron ore bloodletting, and rate-hike fears create elevated downside risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Increase cash and short-duration bonds; avoid long-duration REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA rental inflation concern delays cuts; rising yields pressure REIT valuations

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid capital-weak mining juniors; watch for dilution
defensive_moves.rationale: Canaccord-led cap-raise wave signals sector-wide capital stress; dilution risk elevated

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to consolidate lower as oil-driven rate-hike fears persist and iron ore weakness continues. AUD volatile. RBA on hold. Expect elevated volatility into month-end. Key support for S&P/ASX 200 near recent lows.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Structural themes (energy transition, healthcare, housing affordability) intact. Iron ore correction may create entry points for quality miners. Superannuation system remains robust despite political noise. 6-12 month recovery likely if oil normalises and RBA eases.
key_catalysts: RBA September rate decision and statement on rental inflation
Iron ore price trajectory and Chinese property stimulus
Queensland budget and credit rating follow-through
Superannuation political developments (One Nation, early access)

Brent crude and Australian fuel prices
RBA cash rate and rental CPI data
Chinese PMI, CPI, and property sales data
ASX mining cap-raise volume and dilution metrics
Housing price indices (SQM, CoreLogic) by segment
